pairs.registryProposal: The dispatcher fences untrusted issue text with a label the text cannot close (dispatch.mjs:409-440). That is the untrusted-result-handling discipline applied to prompt input rather than to tool results, so it belongs to a prompt-safety subject, not mcp-tools.
